title: Cyberpunk Edgerunners
description: Interactive archival experience inspired by analog broadcast studio hardware (Sony Trinitron PVM), curved CRT phosphors, and vintage physical VHS cassette sleeves.

featuredSlide.aboutP1: Analog broadcast aesthetics often get lost in flat, modern web design. I set out to build an authentic tactile archival experience evoking vintage CRT studio monitors and physical VHS tape decks for Cyberpunk: Edgerunners.
featuredSlide.aboutP2: I engineered a cylindrical 3D tape carousel in Three.js and React Three Fiber, optical WebGL2 post-processing CRT barrel distortion shaders, procedural Web Audio tape hums and clicks, and a horizontal inertia narrative gallery via Lenis.

caseStudy.tagline: Vintage CRT studio monitor and 3D cylindrical VHS braindance shard archive celebrating Cyberpunk: Edgerunners.
caseStudy.system: Next.js 15 · Three.js · R3F · WebGL2 · Web Audio API · Tailwind

problem.headline: Translating analog broadcast hardware ergonomics and CRT phosphor optics into modern web graphics.
problem.description: Digital archives often lack physical tactility and atmosphere. The challenge was recreating the authentic weight of Sony Trinitron PVM studio monitors, physical VHS cassette sleeves, and CRT phosphor decay while keeping 60 FPS performance on the web.

architecture.headline: Cylindrical Three.js scene graph coupled with custom WebGL2 barrel distortion post-processing.
architecture.description: Engineered an interactive 3D tape carousel using React Three Fiber with custom UV-mapped cassette spines and card wear, layered beneath an offscreen FBO fragment shader simulating optical CRT curvature and scanlines.

highlights.title: Offscreen FBO Barrel Distortion
highlights.detail: Custom WebGL2 fragment shader introducing subtle parabolic barrel curvature (K = 0.07) and phosphor scanlines without DOM layout degradation.

highlights.title: Procedural Audio Oscillator
highlights.detail: Native Web Audio API synthesis generating zero-latency mechanical cassette clicks, switch snaps, and tape hums on user interaction.

highlights.title: Lenis Horizontal Inertia Gallery
highlights.detail: Full-screen horizontal scroll exhibiting 40 curated 1080p anime stills with balanced monochrome-to-color hover reveals.

features.title: 3D Cylindrical Tape Carousel
features.description: Interactive Three.js carousel with realistic cassette sleeve wear, spine typography, and mouse/drag momentum.

features.title: Tactile Audio Feedback Engine
features.description: Synthesizer generating mechanical button snaps, tape deck clatter, and analog hums with zero external audio assets.

features.title: Curated 10-Episode Shard Matrix
features.description: Comprehensive archival index covering all 10 episodes of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners with lore quotes and operational telemetry.

takeaways: Simulating analog hardware requires coupling visual curvature with tactile acoustic feedback — audio synthesis makes flat polygons feel physical.
WebGL2 fragment shaders running on offscreen FBOs allow complex optical lens distortion with negligible CPU overhead.
